profile.name: Marcus Vance
profile.title: Staff Distributed Systems & Infrastructure Architect
profile.bio: Staff Infrastructure Architect with 12+ years of experience designing fault-tolerant distributed databases, high-throughput edge execution runtimes, and multi-region Kubernetes topologies. Open source author of Rust consensus primitives and high-performance network proxies powering 4.8B+ daily requests.
profile.status: Available for Select Advisory & Advisory Eng Roles

experience.summary: Directing the global distributed execution engine and serverless edge runtime spanning 32 PoPs across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
achievements: Architected custom Rust-based WebAssembly edge sandbox reducing cold-start latency from 120ms to 4.2ms at P99 across 32 data centers.
Engineered global Anycast ingress mesh handling 4.8B+ requests/day with automated zero-packet-loss BGP route shifting during ISP outages.
Cut monthly cloud transit and egress expenditure by $380,000 via peer interconnects, UDP packet pacing, and custom zstandard compression buffers.
Mentored a 14-person distributed systems engineering group, instituting deterministic fuzz testing and chaos engineering game days.

experience.summary: Technical lead for the columnar metrics ingestion pipeline, indexing 85M samples per second for Tier-1 enterprise SaaS customers.
achievements: Replaced memory-bound Java time-series ingestion cluster with a SIMD-accelerated Go and Apache Arrow pipeline, yielding a 4.6x throughput boost.
Engineered zero-alloc inverted index caching layer that lowered P99 metric query latencies from 3.8s down to 180ms during heavy incident bursts.
Spearheaded SOC2 Type II compliance audit and end-to-end envelope encryption for cross-tenant time-series datasets.
Authored the company's distributed tracing RFC adopted across 22 microservices teams, integrating OpenTelemetry standards.

experience.summary: Core infrastructure team member maintaining PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant ledger transaction clusters and active-active database replicas.
achievements: Led migration of monolithic payment services into containerized Kubernetes clusters across AWS and Google Cloud Platform with zero downtime.
Built distributed idempotency and distributed lock coordinator in Go/Redis, eliminating recurring $120k duplicate transaction authorizations.
Designed real-time disaster recovery replication keeping cross-region PostgreSQL data loss (RPO) under 2 seconds and RTO under 90 seconds.

experience.summary: Developed low-latency Linux kernel networking patches and high-speed packet capture tools for financial trading data providers.
achievements: Optimized Linux network socket queues and ring buffers (DPDK / AF_XDP), shaving 14 microseconds off multicast UDP packet arrival times.
Automated continuous integration testing across bare-metal server clusters running Debian and RedHat Enterprise Linux.

recommendations.author: Dr. Aris Thorne
recommendations.quote: Marcus is the rare Staff engineer who seamlessly navigates from Linux kernel socket buffers to high-level executive infrastructure roadmaps. His WebAssembly runtime architecture directly reduced our multi-million dollar transit bill while delivering record-low P99 latencies for enterprise workloads.

recommendations.author: Claire Beaumont
recommendations.quote: When our metrics ingestion cluster was buckling under 4x traffic during Black Friday, Marcus led the team with unmatched calm and technical mastery. His SIMD-accelerated pipeline redesign turned a crisis into the most reliable subsystem in our entire architecture.

recommendations.author: Kenji Takahashi
recommendations.quote: In high-stakes PCI-DSS environments, you need engineers who treat distributed state and consensus with absolute mathematical rigor. Marcus Vance is that engineer. His multi-region active replication design set the gold standard across our entire organization.
